title: Music, Maestro!
intro: [excited] Welcome in, music lovers! Warm up those vocal cords, because today's board is all about Disney songs: who sang them, how they end, and which rides they're stuck on FOREVER. Please, no singing at the TV. [sighs] Okay... a little singing.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A grand concert stage at twilight with a glowing orchestra pit, music notes swirling like fireflies into a starry sky, a conductor's baton resting on a velvet podium.

categories.title: Circle of Life
categories.intro: [dramatic] Our film category is The Lion King... a film with a soundtrack fit for a KING.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A dramatic African savanna sunrise with a towering rock outcrop, acacia trees silhouetted against a giant orange sun, herds of zebra and antelope gathering below.

clues.clue: Simba's wise father, the king of Pride Rock, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mufasa! [dramatic] Long live the king. And remember who you are.

clues.clue: Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba this problem-free philosophy in song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hakuna Matata! [sighs] It means no worries for the rest of your days. Must be nice.

clues.clue: Scar sings this villain song while hyenas march below him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Be Prepared! [sarcastic] The hyenas goose-step and Scar plots. Not a great work environment.

clues.clue: Elton John wrote The Lion King's songs with this famous lyricist.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tim Rice! He also wrote lyrics for Aladdin after Howard Ashman passed away. What a career.

clues.clue: The Lion King had three Best Original Song Oscar nominees. This one won.
clues.answer: Can You Feel the Love Tonight
accept: can you feel the love tonight
choices: Can You Feel the Love Tonight
I Just Can't Wait to Be King
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Can You Feel the Love Tonight! [laughs] Circle of Life and Hakuna Matata were nominated too. Timon and Pumbaa were robbed, honestly.

categories.title: Who Sang It?
categories.intro: Next, Who Sang It? I'll name the song, you name the character who sang it.

A row of glowing spotlights on an empty theatre stage, each lighting a different prop: an ice crystal, an ocean wave, a tower window and a lantern.

clues.clue: Let It Go
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elsa! [mischievously] And now it's stuck in your head again. You're welcome.

clues.clue: How Far I'll Go
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! The line where the sky meets the sea, it calls her.

clues.clue: You're Welcome
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maui! [laughs] What can he say except, well, you know. The demigod has a way with a chorus.

clues.clue: Mother Knows Best
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mother Gothel! [sighs] A guilt trip set to music. Rapunzel deserved better.

clues.clue: In Lady and the Tramp, this restaurant owner and his cook Joe serenade the dogs with Bella Notte.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Tony! Joe plays the accordion, Tony sings, and the dogs share some spaghetti. Bella Notte!

categories.title: Song Combos
categories.intro: Time for Song Combos! I've mashed two Disney song titles together where they overlap. [laughs] Name both original songs.

categories.title: Ride Tunes
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category: Ride Tunes! I'll describe a song, you name the attraction it's stuck on.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A colourful theme park boat ride drifting through a twinkling dark tunnel, music notes floating above the water, lanterns and gentle glowing lights.

clues.clue: This boat ride's famous song says it's a world of laughter and a world of tears.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is it's a small world! [laughs] And yes, you will be humming it for the rest of the day.

clues.clue: Yo Ho, A Pirate's Life for Me plays on this boat ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean! [sings] Drink up, me hearties, yo ho. Root beer only, kids.

clues.clue: Grim Grinning Ghosts is the theme song of this spooky attraction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion! [whispers] Even the singing busts in the graveyard are happy to haunt you.

clues.clue: There's a Great Big Beautiful Tomorrow is the theme song of this rotating Tomorrowland show.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Walt Disney's Carousel of Progress! It debuted at the 1964 World's Fair. The theater moves, the family barely ages.

clues.clue: The anthem Golden Dream plays in this EPCOT show hosted by Benjamin Franklin and Mark Twain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The American Adventure! [chuckles] Ben Franklin even climbs stairs in it. That's some serious animatronic cardio.

categories.title: Finish the Lyric
categories.intro: And the fan category: Finish the Lyric! I'll start the line, you finish it. No humming for help. [sighs] Okay, maybe a little.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is down! In the most delightful way, according to Mary Poppins. Practically perfect in every way.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is neat! [mischievously] Wouldn't you think her collection's complete? Spoiler: Ariel wants more.

clues.clue: Look for the bare necessities, the simple bare necessities, forget about your worries and your...
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is strife! Baloo says forget about your worries, and he means it. Mother Nature's recipes, coming right up.
